acolyte.name: Acolyte
acolyte.description: You devoted your youth to temple service, learning sacred rites and channeling divine favor.

artisan.name: Artisan
artisan.description: You honed a craft in an artisan's workshop, gaining a sharp eye for detail and customer trade.

charlatan.name: Charlatan
charlatan.description: You mastered the art of tavern scams, selling comforting lies and forged goods to the gullible.

criminal.name: Criminal
criminal.description: You learned to survive in dark alleyways through picking pockets, burglary, and street smarts.

entertainer.name: Entertainer
entertainer.description: You traveled with carnivals and fairs, captivating crowds with song, dance, and acrobatics.

farmer.name: Farmer
farmer.description: Years tending crops and livestock gave you patience, endurance, and deep respect for nature.

guard.name: Guard
guard.description: You spent long watches on city walls, trained to spot marauders and keep urban order.

guide.name: Guide
guide.description: You grew up exploring untamed wilds, guiding travelers through perilous frontiers.

hermit.name: Hermit
hermit.description: You lived in quiet solitude away from civilization, contemplating creation and wild mysteries.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.description: You learned the flow of trade, buying and selling goods across busy markets and caravans.

noble.name: Noble
noble.description: Raised among wealth and courtly politics, you learned leadership, etiquette, and privilege.

sage.name: Sage
sage.description: You spent long nights in ancient archives, devouring scrolls and mastering arcane lore.

sailor.name: Sailor
sailor.description: You braved ocean storms and foreign ports, forged by a life navigating swaying decks.

scribe.name: Scribe
scribe.description: You trained in scriptoriums copying rare texts, developing meticulous precision and calligraphic skill.

soldier.name: Soldier
soldier.description: Trained for battlefield combat, you carry martial discipline and war memories into every fight.

wayfarer.name: Wayfarer
wayfarer.description: Raised on city streets, you survived hardship through resourcefulness, grit, and hope.

artificer.name: Artificer
artificer.description: Masters of invention who use ingenuity and magic to infuse extraordinary power into objects.

barbarian.name: Barbarian
barbarian.description: Fierce warriors fueled by primal rage, embodying the raw ferocity and stamina of nature.

bard.name: Bard
bard.description: Inspiring performers who weave magic into music, words, and lore to manipulate battle and mind.

dreadnaughtModel.name: Dreadnaught
dreadnaughtModel.summary: Optimize armor model for heavy defense, temporary hit points, and thunder strikes.

guardianModel.name: Guardian
guardianModel.summary: Optimize armor model for front-line defense, thunder pulse strikes, and temporary hit points.

infiltratorModel.name: Infiltrator
infiltratorModel.summary: Optimize armor model for stealth, speed, and ranged lightning attacks.

arcaneConduit.name: Arcane Conduit
arcaneConduit.summary: Channel arcane energy through your armor to add Intelligence modifier to damage spells.

ferocity.name: Ferocity
ferocity.summary: Empower your steel defender with ferocious combat reflexes.

owl.name: Owl Aspect
owl.summary: Gain swift movement and aerial agility inspired by the owl spirit.

panther.name: Panther Aspect
panther.summary: Gain stalking stealth and pouncing strikes inspired by the panther spirit.

salmon.name: Salmon Aspect
salmon.summary: Gain powerful swimming and stubborn endurance inspired by the salmon spirit.

divineStrike.name: Divine Strike
divineStrike.summary: Infuse your weapon attacks with extra holy energy once per turn.

potentSpellcastingCleric.name: Potent Spellcasting
potentSpellcastingCleric.summary: Add Wisdom modifier to the damage dealt by your cleric cantrips.

protector.name: Protector
protector.summary: Gain heavy armor proficiency and martial weapon training.

thaumaturge.name: Thaumaturge
thaumaturge.summary: Gain extra holy cantrips and bonus Religion skill checks.

aridLand.name: Arid Land
aridLand.summary: Adapt your circle magic to desert and sun-scorched environments.

polarLand.name: Polar Land
polarLand.summary: Adapt your circle magic to icy, frost-covered environments.

temperateLand.name: Temperate Land
temperateLand.summary: Adapt your circle magic to lush forests and temperate wilderness.

tropicalLand.name: Tropical Land
tropicalLand.summary: Adapt your circle magic to dense jungle and tropical environments.

potentSpellcasting.name: Potent Spellcasting
potentSpellcasting.summary: Add Wisdom modifier to the damage dealt by your cleric cantrips.

primalStrike.name: Primal Strike
primalStrike.summary: Infuse weapon and beast strikes with extra elemental damage.

magician.name: Magician
magician.summary: Learn extra nature cantrips and gain bonus Nature skill checks.

warden.name: Warden
warden.summary: Gain martial weapon training and medium armor defense.

banishingShot.name: Banishing Shot
banishingShot.summary: Temporarily banish the target to a harmless demiplane.

beguilingShot.name: Beguiling Shot
beguilingShot.summary: Deal extra psychic damage and charm the target toward an ally.

burstingShot.name: Bursting Shot
burstingShot.summary: Cause an explosion of force damage around the target.

enfeeblingShot.name: Enfeebling Shot
enfeeblingShot.summary: Deal extra necrotic damage and halve the target's weapon attack damage.

graspingShot.name: Grasping Shot
graspingShot.summary: Entangle the target with brambles, reducing speed and dealing damage when moving.

piercingShot.name: Piercing Shot
piercingShot.summary: Fire an arrow that pierces through all creatures in a 30-foot line.

seekingShot.name: Seeking Shot
seekingShot.summary: Fire an arrow that seeks out a hidden target.

shadowShot.name: Shadow Shot
shadowShot.summary: Deal extra psychic damage and blind the target beyond 5 feet.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.summary: Add a maneuver die to a Dexterity (Stealth) check or Initiative roll.

baitAndSwitch.name: Bait and Switch
baitAndSwitch.summary: Swap places with a willing ally and boost AC.

commandersStrike.name: Commander's Strike
commandersStrike.summary: Forgo an attack to direct an ally to strike with extra damage.

commandingPresence.name: Commanding Presence
commandingPresence.summary: Add a maneuver die to Charisma (Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion) checks.

disarmingAttack.name: Disarming Attack
disarmingAttack.summary: Deal extra damage and force the target to drop an item.

distractingStrike.name: Distracting Strike
distractingStrike.summary: Deal extra damage and distract the target, giving an ally Advantage on its next attack.

evasiveFootwork.name: Evasive Footwork
evasiveFootwork.summary: Add a maneuver die to your AC while moving.

feintingAttack.name: Feinting Attack
feintingAttack.summary: Feint to gain advantage and extra damage on your next attack roll.

goadingAttack.name: Goading Attack
goadingAttack.summary: Goad a target into focusing its attacks solely on you.

lungingAttack.name: Lunging Attack
lungingAttack.summary: Increase your melee attack reach and deal extra damage.

maneuveringAttack.name: Maneuvering Attack
maneuveringAttack.summary: Deal extra damage and allow an ally to reposition safely.

menacingAttack.name: Menacing Attack
menacingAttack.summary: Deal extra damage and frighten the target.

parry.name: Parry
parry.summary: Use your reaction to reduce incoming melee damage.

precisionAttack.name: Precision Attack
precisionAttack.summary: Add a maneuver die to an attack roll to ensure a hit.

pushingAttack.name: Pushing Attack
pushingAttack.summary: Deal extra damage and push the target back up to 15 feet.

rally.name: Rally
rally.summary: Bolster an ally with temporary hit points using your maneuver die.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.summary: Use your reaction to strike back when an enemy misses you.

sweepingAttack.name: Sweeping Attack
sweepingAttack.summary: Sweep your weapon to deal damage to a second nearby target.

tacticalAssessment.name: Tactical Assessment
tacticalAssessment.summary: Add a maneuver die to History, Insight, or Investigation checks.

tripAttack.name: Trip Attack
tripAttack.summary: Deal extra damage and knock a target prone.

blessedWarrior.name: Blessed Warrior
blessedWarrior.summary: Learn two cleric cantrips of your choice.

druidicWarrior.name: Druidic Warrior
druidicWarrior.summary: Learn two druid cantrips of your choice.

biofeedback.name: Biofeedback
biofeedback.summary: Gain Temporary Hit Points when casting Necromancy or Transmutation spells.

bolsteringPrecognition.name: Bolstering Precognition
bolsteringPrecognition.summary: Grant a bonus to a creature's next D20 Test when casting Abjuration or Divination spells.

destructiveThoughts.name: Destructive Thoughts
destructiveThoughts.summary: Deal extra Psychic damage to a target when casting Conjuration or Evocation saving throw spells.

devilishTongue.name: Devilish Tongue
devilishTongue.summary: Add a Psionic Energy Die to an Influence ability check.

expandedAwareness.name: Expanded Awareness
expandedAwareness.summary: Add a Psionic Energy Die to a Search ability check.

idInsinuation.name: Id Insinuation
idInsinuation.summary: Subtract half a Psionic Energy Die roll from a target's save against your Enchantment or Illusion spells.

inerrantAim.name: Inerrant Aim
inerrantAim.summary: Add a Psionic Energy Die to a missed attack roll.

observantMind.name: Observant Mind
observantMind.summary: Add a Psionic Energy Die to a Study ability check.

psionicBacklash.name: Psionic Backlash
psionicBacklash.summary: Reduce incoming attack damage and deal Psychic damage back to the attacker.

psionicGuards.name: Psionic Guards
psionicGuards.summary: Gain Immunity to Charmed/Frightened conditions and Advantage on Int saves.

sharpenedMind.name: Sharpened Mind
sharpenedMind.summary: Ignore Psychic resistance and substitute a recorded Psionic die roll on damage once per turn.

escapeTheHorde.name: Escape the Horde
escapeTheHorde.summary: Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you.
escapeTheHorde.description: Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you.

multiattackDefense.name: Multiattack Defense
multiattackDefense.summary: Attacks from a creature hit you with have Disadvantage for the rest of the turn.
multiattackDefense.description: When a creature hits you with an attack roll, that creature has Disadvantage on all other attack rolls against you this turn.

colossusSlayer.name: Colossus Slayer
colossusSlayer.summary: Deal extra damage once per turn to creatures below their hit point max.
colossusSlayer.description: On a hit, once per turn, if the target is missing any of its Hit Points, the target takes an extra 1d8 damage.

hordeBreaker.name: Horde Breaker
hordeBreaker.summary: Make an extra weapon attack against another creature adjacent to your target.
hordeBreaker.description: Once per turn, you can make another attack against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the target, that is within the weapon's range, and that you haven't attacked this turn.

bhaalPact.name: Aspect of Slaughter
bhaalPact.summary: Gain poison resistance and learn the Blade Ward cantrip.

myrkulPact.name: Aspect of Mortality
myrkulPact.summary: Gain necrotic resistance and learn the Chill Touch cantrip.

acidAffinity.name: Acid Affinity
acidAffinity.summary: Gain acid resistance and add Charisma modifier to acid damage spells.

coldAffinity.name: Cold Affinity
coldAffinity.summary: Gain cold resistance and add Charisma modifier to cold damage spells.

fireAffinity.name: Fire Affinity
fireAffinity.summary: Gain fire resistance and add Charisma modifier to fire damage spells.

lightningAffinity.name: Lightning Affinity
lightningAffinity.summary: Gain lightning resistance and add Charisma modifier to lightning damage spells.

poisonAffinity.name: Poison Affinity
poisonAffinity.summary: Gain poison resistance and add Charisma modifier to poison damage spells.

carefulSpell.name: Careful Spell
carefulSpell.summary: Protect chosen allies from taking full damage from area spells.

distantSpell.name: Distant Spell
distantSpell.summary: Double the range of a spell or turn a touch spell into range.

empoweredSpell.name: Empowered Spell
empoweredSpell.summary: Reroll damage dice on a spell to maximize your damage output.

extendedSpell.name: Extended Spell
extendedSpell.summary: Double the duration of a spell up to a maximum of 24 hours.

heightenedSpell.name: Heightened Spell
heightenedSpell.summary: Impose disadvantage on a target's first saving throw against your spell.

quickenedSpell.name: Quickened Spell
quickenedSpell.summary: Change a spell with a casting time of 1 action to 1 Bonus Action.

seekingSpell.name: Seeking Spell
seekingSpell.summary: Reroll a missed spell attack roll to turn a miss into a hit.

subtleSpell.name: Subtle Spell
subtleSpell.summary: Cast a spell without needing verbal or somatic components.

transmutedSpell.name: Transmuted Spell
transmutedSpell.summary: Change the elemental damage type of a spell to another elemental damage type.

twinnedSpell.name: Twinned Spell
twinnedSpell.summary: Target a second creature with a spell that normally targets only one.

agonizingBlast.name: Agonizing Blast
agonizingBlast.summary: Add your Charisma modifier to the damage of your Eldritch Blast.

armorOfShadows.name: Armor of Shadows
armorOfShadows.summary: Cast Mage Armor on yourself at will without spell slots.

ascendantStep.name: Ascendant Step
ascendantStep.summary: Cast Levitate on yourself at will without spell slots.

devilSight.name: Devil's Sight
devilSight.summary: See normally in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, to a distance of 120 feet.

eldritchMind.name: Eldritch Mind
eldritchMind.summary: Gain advantage on Constitution saves to maintain spell concentration.

eldritchSmite.name: Eldritch Smite
eldritchSmite.summary: Expend a spell slot to deal extra force damage and knock a target prone.

eldritchSpear.name: Eldritch Spear
eldritchSpear.summary: Increase the range of your Eldritch Blast cantrip.

fiendishVigor.name: Fiendish Vigor
fiendishVigor.summary: Cast False Life on yourself at will to gain temporary hit points.

gazeOfTwoMinds.name: Gaze of Two Minds
gazeOfTwoMinds.summary: Perceive through the senses of a willing humanoid target.

giftOfTheDepths.name: Gift of the Depths
giftOfTheDepths.summary: Gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed and the ability to breathe underwater.

investmentOfTheChainMaster.name: Investment of the Chain Master
investmentOfTheChainMaster.summary: Enhance your familiar with flying/swimming speed and boosted attacks.

lessonsOfTheFirstOnes.name: Lessons of the First Ones
lessonsOfTheFirstOnes.summary: Gain an Origin Feat of your choice.

maskOfManyFaces.name: Mask of Many Faces
maskOfManyFaces.summary: Cast Disguise Self at will without expending spell slots.

masterOfMyriadForms.name: Master of Myriad Forms
masterOfMyriadForms.summary: Cast Alter Self at will without expending spell slots.

mistyVisions.name: Misty Visions
mistyVisions.summary: Cast Silent Image at will without expending a spell slot.

oneWithShadows.name: One with Shadows
oneWithShadows.summary: Become invisible in dim light or darkness when remaining still.

otherworldlyLeap.name: Otherworldly Leap
otherworldlyLeap.summary: Cast Jump on yourself at will without expending spell slots.

pactOfTheBladeFolder.name: Pact of the Blade
pactOfTheBladeFolder.summary: Summon or bind a magical pact weapon in your hand.

pactOfTheChainFolder.name: Pact of the Chain
pactOfTheChainFolder.summary: Gain an upgraded imp, pseudodragon, quasit, or sprite familiar.

pactOfTheChainAttack.name: Command Familiar
pactOfTheChainAttack.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one attack with a command to your familiar to make one attack with its Reaction.

pactOfTheTomeFolder.name: Pact of the Tome
pactOfTheTomeFolder.summary: Gain a grimoire containing three cantrips from any spell list.

repellingBlast.name: Repelling Blast
repellingBlast.summary: Push a target up to 10 feet away when hitting with Eldritch Blast.

thirstingBlade.name: Thirsting Blade
thirstingBlade.summary: Attack twice with your pact weapon whenever you take the Attack action.

whispersOfTheGrave.name: Whispers of the Grave
whispersOfTheGrave.summary: Cast Speak with Dead at will without expending spell slots.

lifeDomainVestige.name: Life Domain
lifeDomainVestige.summary: Gain divine healing spells and heavy armor proficiency from the Life Domain.

lightDomainVestige.name: Light Domain
lightDomainVestige.summary: Gain radiant fire spells and warding flares from the Light Domain.

trickeryDomainVestige.name: Trickery Domain
trickeryDomainVestige.summary: Gain illusory stealth spells and trickster duplicates from the Trickery Domain.

warDomainVestige.name: War Domain
warDomainVestige.summary: Gain bonus weapon strikes and protective barrier spells from the War Domain.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.description: Divine champions who channel holy magic to heal allies, smite foes, and serve their deity.

druid.name: Druid
druid.description: Guardians of nature who wield primal magic and shape-shift into dangerous wilderness beasts.

fighter.name: Fighter
fighter.description: Unmatched martial experts skilled with every weapon and armor to dominate the battlefield.

monk.name: Monk
monk.description: Ascetic martial artists who harness inner focus to strike with lightning speed and precision.

evasion.name: Evasion
evasion.description: When you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed and only half damage if you fail.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.description: Holy warriors bound by sacred oaths, smiting evil with radiant power and protective auras.

psion.name: Psion
psion.description: Masters of psionic power who weave magic and extraordinary powers through the raw force of their minds.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.description: Deadly wilderness scouts and trackers who combine martial skill with nature magic.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.description: Cunning tricksters who rely on stealth, precision, and vulnerability to strike effectively.

sorcerer.name: Sorcerer
sorcerer.description: Spellcasters carrying innate magic in their bloodline, twisting raw arcana at will.

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.description: Combine reagents to produce magical effects, using creations to give life and to leech it away.

armorer.name: Armorer
armorer.description: Modify armor to function as a second skin, enhancing magic, attacks, and generating defense.

artillerist.name: Artillerist
artillerist.description: Specialize in using magic to hurl energy, projectiles, and deadly explosions on the battlefield.

battleSmith.name: Battle Smith
battleSmith.description: Combine protection and healing, accompanied by a loyal Steel Defender of your own creation.

cartographer.name: Cartographer
cartographer.description: Navigate and scout, using your creations to highlight threats, safeguard allies, and carve portals.

reanimator.name: Reanimator
reanimator.description: Stitch together servants from corpses, transforming the dark art of necromancy into a grim science.

ancestralGuardian.name: Path of the Ancestral Guardian
ancestralGuardian.description: Commune with the spirits of your ancestors, calling them forth to shield allies and harass enemies.

berserker.name: Path of the Berserker
berserker.description: Direct your Rage toward violence, thrilling in untrammeled fury and the chaos of battle.

lament.name: Path of the Lament
lament.description: Draw upon mournful departed spirits, unleashing their sorrow in terrifying wails and strikes.

wildHeart.name: Path of the Wild Heart
wildHeart.description: Communicate with animals and channel supernatural might as your Rage deepens your primal connection.

worldTree.name: Path of the World Tree
worldTree.description: Connect with the cosmic World Tree through your Rage, drawing on its magic for vitality and travel.

zealot.name: Path of the Zealot
zealot.description: Receive boons from a god, experiencing Rage as a divine union that infuses you with holy power.

dance.name: College of Dance
dance.description: Harmonize with the whirling cosmos through agile, speedy, and graceful dances that weave magic.

glamour.name: College of Glamour
glamour.description: Weave threads of Feywild beauty and terror into your performances to cloak yourself in majesty.

lore.name: College of Lore
lore.description: Collect spells and secrets from diverse sources, uncovering ancient knowledge and mystical rites.

moon.name: College of the Moon
moon.description: Draw inspiration from lunar phases, blending moonlit secrets with martial and druidic magic.

inspiredEclipse.name: Inspired Eclipse
inspiredEclipse.description: You can gain the Invisible condition and teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. The invisibility lasts until the start of your next turn or until you attack, deal damage, or cast a spell.

spirits.name: College of Spirits
spirits.description: Commune with past spirits, channeling their stories and wisdom to perform wondrous magic.

valor.name: College of Valor
valor.description: Sing tales of the mighty in combat, preserving the memories of great heroes as a daring storyteller.

graveDomain.name: Grave Domain
graveDomain.description: Guard the boundary between life and death, drawing upon transitional energy to heal or smite.

circleOfMortalityHealing.name: Circle of Mortality
circleOfMortalityHealing.description: When restoring Hit Points to a creature at 0 Hit Points, use the highest possible roll for each die.

knowledgeDomain.name: Knowledge Domain
knowledgeDomain.description: Value learning and information, using divine insights to uncover secrets and influence minds.

lifeDomain.name: Life Domain
lifeDomain.description: Tap into the positive energy of the multiverse as a master of healing, using life force to cure.

discipleOfLife.name: Disciple of Life
discipleOfLife.description: The creature regains an additional $(2+(stats.wis.mod)) Hit Points.

blessedHealer.name: Blessed Healer
blessedHealer.description: If you cast this on another creature, you regain $(2+(stats.wis.mod)) Hit Points.

lightDomain.name: Light Domain
lightDomain.description: Emphasize the divine power of blazing fire and revelation, burning away darkness and chasing away lies.

trickeryDomain.name: Trickery Domain
trickeryDomain.description: Wield magic of deception, illusion, and stealth as a disruptive force puncturing pride and tyranny.

warDomain.name: War Domain
warDomain.description: Excel in battle by tapping into the magic of war, inspiring others or offering violence as a prayer.

circleOfPreservation.name: Circle of Preservation
circleOfPreservation.description: Defend natural sanctuaries, revitalize damaged land, and protect allies from toxic or hostile elements.

circleOfTheLand.name: Circle of the Land
circleOfTheLand.description: Safeguard ancient knowledge and rites as a mystic and sage, whispering primal secrets in Druidic.

circleOfTheMoon.name: Circle of the Moon
circleOfTheMoon.description: Draw on lunar magic to transform yourself into various beasts, changeable and powerful as the moon.

circleOfTheSea.name: Circle of the Sea
circleOfTheSea.description: Draw on the tempestuous forces of oceans and storms, embodying nature's wrath or mystical unity.

circleOfTheStars.name: Circle of the Stars
circleOfTheStars.description: Track heavenly patterns to discover cosmic secrets, harnessing the power of constellations.

circleOfTheTitan.name: Circle of the Titan
circleOfTheTitan.description: Channel cataclysmic power of giant monsters, adopting colossal Titan Forms and unleashing shock waves.

arcaneArcher.name: Arcane Archer
arcaneArcher.description: Study a unique method of elven archery that weaves magic into shots to create supernatural effects.

banneret.name: Banneret
banneret.description: Rally allies to fight against evil as a paragon of valor, utilizing inspiring presence and diplomacy.

battleMaster.name: Battle Master
battleMaster.description: Combine honed combat skills with academic study to master martial techniques passed down generations.

champion.name: Champion
champion.description: Focus on martial prowess and relentless pursuit of victory to deal devastating blows and garner glory.

improvedCritical.name: Improved Critical
improvedCritical.description: You score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20. Then, you can move $(Math.floor(attributes.movement.walk / 2 / 5) * 5) feet.

eldritchKnight.name: Eldritch Knight
eldritchKnight.description: Combine martial mastery with a careful study of magic, casting spells to extend your combat skills.

psiWarrior.name: Psi Warrior
psiWarrior.description: Awaken the power of your mind to augment physical might, infusing weapon strikes with psionic power.

elements.name: Warrior of the Elements
elements.description: Harness elemental power to shape strikes, manifest reaching tendrils, and unleash devastating bursts.

mercy.name: Warrior of Mercy
mercy.description: Manipulate life force as a masked wandering physician, acting as a faceless bringer of life and death.

mysticArts.name: Warrior of the Mystic Arts
mysticArts.description: Wield magic to supplement martial skill, harnessing supernatural focus to enhance magical and physical abilities.

openHand.name: Warrior of the Open Hand
openHand.description: Master unarmed combat with techniques to push, trip, and manipulate energy to protect against harm.

shadows.name: Warrior of Shadow
shadows.description: Practice stealth and subterfuge by harnessing Shadowfell power to hide, shadow-leap, and become wraithlike.

venom.name: Warrior of Venom
venom.description: Harvest blood toxins to coat weapons in debilitating poison and use toxic touches to sedate or charm.

oathOfDevotion.name: Oath of Devotion
oathOfDevotion.description: Bind yourself to Justice and Order, embodying the classic archetype of a knight in shining armor.

oathOfGenies.name: Oath of the Noble Genies
oathOfGenies.description: Pledge to noble Genies, channeling ancient elemental magic and wielding divine, elementally-infused armor.

oathOfGlory.name: Oath of Glory
oathOfGlory.description: Embrace a destiny of greatness, leading companions to achieve immortal glory through heroic deeds.

oathOfTheAncients.name: Oath of the Ancients
oathOfTheAncients.description: Cherish the light, loving the beautiful and life-giving things of the world above all other principles.

oathOfVengeance.name: Oath of Vengeance
oathOfVengeance.description: Make a solemn commitment to hunt down and relentlessly punish those who have committed grievously evil acts.

oathbreaker.name: Oathbreaker
oathbreaker.description: Break your sacred vows to pursue dark ambitions, extinguishing the light in your heart for demonic power.

metamorph.name: Metamorph
metamorph.description: Psychically sculpt life and flesh, molding your body into the ultimate weapon and vessel for psionic power.

psiWarper.name: Psi Warper
psiWarper.description: Tune psionic powers to manipulate space between objects, teleporting across battlefields and warping space.

psykinetic.name: Psykinetic
psykinetic.description: Mold psionic force like a malleable tool, erecting sturdy barriers and striking with the force of a battering ram.

telekineticTechniques.description:
You can roll 5d4 instead of expending a Psionic Energy Die.

When a target fails its saving throw, you can impose one of the following effects:
* **Boost.** The target's Speed increases by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
* **Disorient.** The target cannot make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.
* **Telekinetic Bolt.** The target takes Force damage equal to the number rolled on the die.

reboundingField.name: Rebounding Field
reboundingField.description: The attacker must make a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d$(attributes.psiDice)$(formatBonus(stats.int.mod)) Force damage on a failed save, or half on a success. You gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the damage dealt.

seer.name: Seer
seer.description: Master the stream of time and foresight, slipping through attacks, guiding allies, and altering outcomes.

shaper.name: Shaper
shaper.description: Manifest raw mental mass, ectoplasm, and psionic constructs from the Astral Plane to fight alongside you.

telepath.name: Telepath
telepath.description: Master tactics in the landscape of the mind, bolstering mental defenses of allies and probing thoughts undetected.

beastMaster.name: Beast Master
beastMaster.description: Form a mystical bond with a special animal, drawing on primal magic and deep natural connection.

commandPrimalCompanionAttack.name: Primal Companion Command
commandPrimalCompanionAttack.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one attack with a command to your Primal Companion to take the Beast's Strike action.

feyWanderer.name: Fey Wanderer
feyWanderer.description: Embody a fey mystique to brighten hearts with joyful laughter and strike terror with martial prowess.

gloomStalker.name: Gloom Stalker
gloomStalker.description: Feel at home in the darkest places, wielding Shadowfell magic to combat enemies lurking in darkness.

hollowWarden.name: Hollow Warden
hollowWarden.description: Draw power from ancient horrors to grow bark armor and unleash nature's primal, terrifying vengeance.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: Stalk prey in the wilds, using your abilities as a Hunter to protect nature and people everywhere.

winterWalker.name: Winter Walker
winterWalker.description: Thrive in frozen tundras, channeling frost and rime to shield yourself and paralyze your prey.

bitingCold.name: Biting Cold
bitingCold.description: Your Cold damage ignores Resistance to Cold damage.

arcaneTrickster.name: Arcane Trickster
arcaneTrickster.description: Enhance your stealth and agility with spells, learning magical tricks for burglary or pranks.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.description: Use stealth, poison, and disguise to eliminate foes with deadly efficiency as a trained killer.

surprisingStrikesAttack.name: Surprising Strike Advantage
surprisingStrikesAttack.description: During the first round of each combat, you have Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn.

phantom.name: Phantom

scion.name: Scion
scion.description: Channel dark power through malevolent dread aspects, shifting your allegiance to unleash sinister magic.

soulknife.name: Soulknife
soulknife.description: Strike with your mind, channeling innate psionic power to cut through physical and psychic barriers.

thief.name: Thief
thief.description: Mix burglary and exploration, gaining abilities to delve into ruins and maximize magic item benefits.

aberrant.name: Aberrant Sorcery
aberrant.description: Wield psionic power granted by an alien influence, touching minds and altering the world around you.

clockwork.name: Clockwork Sorcery
clockwork.description: Channel the cosmic force of order, utilizing clockwork magic from Mechanus to manipulate reality.

demonic.name: Demonic Sorcery
demonic.description: Draw magic from a rift to the Abyss, tearing open ruptures to channel chaotic demonic power.

draconic.name: Draconic Sorcery

shadow.name: Shadow Sorcery
shadow.description: Draw magic from the Shadowfell to command darkness, wrap yourself in gloom, and summon foul beasts.

wildMagic.name: Wild Magic Sorcery
wildMagic.description: Channel the underlying chaos of creation, unleashing unpredictable raw magic in spectacular bursts.

archfeyPatron.description: Draw power from the Feywild, making a pact with a powerful archfey to weave beguiling, mirthful magic.

stepsOfTheFeyLevel6Options.name: Steps of the Fey Level 6 Options

undeadPatron.name: Undead Patron

abjurer.name: Abjurer

bladesinger.name: Bladesinger

evoker.name: Evoker

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.description: Explore the cosmic forces of life and death, draining life force and raising loyal undead thralls.

overwhelmingNecrosis.name: Overwhelming Necrosis
overwhelmingNecrosis.description: Your Necromancy spells ignore Resistance to Necrotic damage.

wizard.name: Wizard

charger.summary: Gain extra momentum and damage when charging into melee after a dash.

chef.summary: Cook delicious meals that bolster allies with extra healing and temporary hit points.

mageSlayer.summary: Punish spellcasters in close proximity and disrupt their concentration.

mageSlayerConcentrationBreaker.description: On a hit, the target has Disadvantage on any saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration.

mediumArmorMaster.name: Medium Armor Master
mediumArmorMaster.summary: Move stealthily in medium armor and maximize Dexterity defense benefits.

moderatelyArmored.name: Moderately Armored
moderatelyArmored.summary: Gain proficiency with Medium Armor and Shields.

mountedCombatant.summary: Gain tactical advantage and protective maneuvers while mounted.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.description: On a miss, while hidden, making the attack roll doesn't reveal your location.

slasher.name: Slasher
slasher.summary: Slashing strikes slow enemies and weaken their retaliatory attacks.

speedy.name: Speedy
speedy.summary: Increase movement speed and ignore difficult terrain penalty when dashing.

speedyAgileMovement.name: Agile Movement
speedyAgileMovement.description: Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement when Dashing.

spellSniper.name: Spell Sniper
spellSniper.summary: Double spell range, ignore cover, and learn a offensive cantrip.

spellSniperBypassCover.name: Bypass Cover
spellSniperBypassCover.description: Your spell attacks ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

spellSniperCastingInMelee.name: Casting in Melee
spellSniperCastingInMelee.description: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your spell attack rolls.

telekinetic.name: Telekinetic
telekinetic.summary: Learn invisible Mage Hand and telekinetically shove foes or allies.

telepathic.name: Telepathic
telepathic.summary: Speak telepathically with nearby creatures and read surface thoughts.

warCaster.name: War Caster
warCaster.summary: Maintain spell concentration effortlessly and cast spells as opportunity attacks.

weaponMaster.name: Weapon Master
weaponMaster.summary: Master training in four chosen weapons of your choice.

alert.name: Alert
alert.summary: Swap initiative order with willing allies and avoid being surprised.

crafter.name: Crafter
crafter.summary: Craft gear during long rests at a discount and reduced time.

healer.name: Healer
healer.summary: Use healer kits to restore hit points and stabilize dying allies.

healingRerolls.name: Healing Rerolls
healingRerolls.description: You can reroll healing once per turn.

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.summary: Expend luck points to gain advantage on rolls or impose disadvantage on foes.

magicInitiateCleric.name: Cleric Initiate
magicInitiateCleric.summary: Learn divine cantrips and a 1st-level cleric spell.

magicInitiateDruid.name: Druid Initiate
magicInitiateDruid.summary: Learn nature cantrips and a 1st-level druid spell.

magicInitiateWizard.name: Wizard Initiate
magicInitiateWizard.summary: Learn arcane cantrips and a 1st-level wizard spell.

musician.name: Musician
musician.summary: Perform music during rests to grant allies inspiration.

savageAttacker.name: Savage Attacker
savageAttacker.summary: Reroll weapon damage dice once per turn and take the higher total.
savageAttacker.description: You can reroll damage once per turn.

skilled.name: Skilled
skilled.summary: Gain proficiency in three skills or tools of your choice.

tavernBrawler.name: Tavern Brawler
tavernBrawler.summary: Excel in brawling, improvised weapons, and swift grappling.

tough.name: Tough
tough.summary: Increase maximum hit points substantially at every level.

aasimar.name: Aasimar
aasimar.description: Mortals who carry a spark of the Upper Planes, bringing light, healing, and celestial fury.

dragonborn.name: Dragonborn
dragonborn.description: Descendants of metallic and chromatic dragons with scaly skin and elemental breath weapons.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.description: Resilient folk forged from stone and metal, enduring as the mountains with an affinity for craft.

elf.name: Elf
elf.description: Magical, long-lived beings born of the Feywild who rest in a trance rather than sleep.

trance.name: Trance

gith.name: Gith
gith.description: Planar travelers forged by ancestral psionic potential, divided into the martial Githyanki and the disciplined Githzerai.

gnome.name: Gnome
gnome.description: Petite, inventive folk imbued with wild wonder, keen intellect, and natural magic.

goliath.name: Goliath
goliath.description: Towering descendants of giants who command supernatural martial boons and sudden growth.

halfling.name: Halfling
halfling.description: Small, nimble folk blessed with extraordinary luck, bravery, and a love for hearth and home.

halflingNimbleness.name: Halfling Nimbleness
halflingNimbleness.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you.

luck.name: Luck
luck.description: You can reroll any 1 on a D20.

naturallyStealthy.name: Naturally Stealthy
naturallyStealthy.description: You can Hide when obscured by a creature at least one size larger than you.

human.name: Human

resourceful.name: Resourceful
resourceful.description: You gain Inspiration at the end of a Long Rest.

leonin.name: Leonin
leonin.description: Fierce, golden-furred hunters who value pride, martial prowess, and fierce independence.

minotaur.name: Minotaur
minotaur.description: Powerful horned humanoids with an uncanny sense of direction and relentless charge.

orc.name: Orc
orc.description: Strong, driven warriors endowed with Gruumsh's endurance, unyielding grit, and darkvision.

satyr.name: Satyr
satyr.description: Fey revelers with goatlike legs whose music and magic thrive on unbridled joy.

tiefling.name: Tiefling
tiefling.description: Mortals carrying a fiendish heritage that sparks supernatural power and planar resistance.

triton.name: Triton
triton.description: Aquatic guardians from the Plane of Water who defend both ocean depths and surface shores.

warforged.name: Warforged
warforged.description: Mechanical beings, infused with alchemical fluids and wooden-metal bodies capable of pain and emotion.

sentrysRest.name: Sentry's Rest
sentrysRest.description: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 6 hours if you spend those hours in an inactive, motionless state. During this time, you appear inert but remain conscious.

tireless.name: Tireless
tireless.description: You don't gain Exhaustion levels from dehydration, malnutrition, or suffocation.

acidSplash.name: Acid Splash
acidSplash.summary: You hurl a bubble of acid that bursts into a damaging splash.

bladeWard.name: Blade Ward
bladeWard.summary: You ward yourself against weapon attacks.

chillTouch.summary: You channel skeletal cold to strike a target and hamper its healing.

dancingLights.name: Dancing Lights
dancingLights.summary: You create up to four lights that hover or move at your command.

druidcraft.name: Druidcraft
druidcraft.summary: You channel nature magic to create subtle wilderness effects.

eldritchBlast.name: Eldritch Blast

elementalism.name: Elementalism

fireBolt.summary: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or an object.

friends.name: Friends

guidance.summary: You touch a creature to grant a minor boost to its next skill check.

lightSpell.name: Light
lightSpell.summary: You make an object shine with bright light.

mageHand.summary: You create a spectral hand to manipulate objects at a distance.

mending.name: Mending
mending.summary: You repair a single break or tear in an object.

message.summary: You whisper a secret message to a target at a distance.

mindSliver.name: Mind Sliver
mindSliver.summary: You drive a disorienting spike of psychic energy into a target mind.

minorIllusion.name: Minor Illusion
minorIllusion.summary: You create a sound or an image of an object within range.

poisonSpray.name: Poison Spray
poisonSpray.summary: You project a puff of noxious gas at a nearby creature.

prestidigitation.name: Prestidigitation
prestidigitation.summary: You perform minor magical tricks and utility effects.

produceFlame.name: Produce Flame
produceFlame.summary: A flickering flame appears in your hand for light or throwing.

rayOfFrost.name: Ray of Frost
rayOfFrost.summary: A frigid beam of blue-white light strikes and slows a target.

sacredFlame.name: Sacred Flame
sacredFlame.summary: Flame-like radiance descends on a target.

shillelagh.name: Shillelagh
shillelagh.summary: Nature magic imbues your wooden weapon with force.

shockingGrasp.name: Shocking Grasp
shockingGrasp.summary: Lightning springs from your hand to shock a target.

sorcerousBurst.name: Sorcerous Burst

spareTheDying.name: Spare the Dying

starryWisp.name: Starry Wisp
starryWisp.summary: You launch a twinkling mote of light that illuminates a target.

telekineticFling.name: Telekinetic Fling
telekineticFling.summary: You wreathe a small object in psionic energy and launch it at a target.

thaumaturgy.name: Thaumaturgy
thaumaturgy.summary: You manifest minor wonders and supernatural signs.

thornWhip.name: Thorn Whip
thornWhip.summary: You create a thorny whip to strike and pull a target closer.

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.summary: You create a burst of thunderous noise that damages nearby targets.

tollTheDead.name: Toll the Dead
tollTheDead.summary: A painful bell toll echoes, dealing necrotic damage.

trueStrike.name: True Strike
trueStrike.summary: Magical insight guides your next strike.

viciousMockery.name: Vicious Mockery
viciousMockery.summary: You unleash subtle enchantments to disorient a creature.

alarm.name: Alarm
alarm.summary: You set a magical alarm against intrusion.

animalFriendship.name: Animal Friendship
animalFriendship.summary: You convince a beast that you mean it no harm.

armorOfAgathys.name: Eldritch Armor

armsOfHadar.name: Eldritch Arms
armsOfHadar.summary: Dark tendrils erupt around you to strike nearby foes.

bane.name: Bane

bless.name: Bless
bless.summary: You bless up to three allies, boosting their attacks and saves.

burningHands.name: Burning Hands
burningHands.summary: A thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your fingertips.

charmPerson.name: Charm Person

chromaticOrb.name: Chromatic Orb
chromaticOrb.summary: You hurl an orb of elemental energy at a target.

colorSpray.name: Color Spray
colorSpray.summary: You launch a dazzling array of flashing lights to blind targets.

detectPoisonAndDisease.summary: You sense the location of poisons, venom, and contagions.

divineFavor.name: Divine Favor
